name: Cafe Bacchus
description_short: Cosy village cafe in Storms River serving hearty breakfasts, fresh salads, and comfort food near Tsitsikamma.
description_long:
Tucked into the heart of Storms River village, Cafe Bacchus offers a welcome respite for adventurers exploring the nearby Tsitsikamma forests and coastline. The cafe's relaxed atmosphere makes it an ideal spot to fuel up before a hike or unwind after a day on the trails.

The menu focuses on wholesome, uncomplicated fare—think generous breakfast plates, fresh garden salads, toasted sandwiches, and warming soups. It's the kind of place where locals and visitors mingle over good coffee and honest comfort food. The compact setting feels more neighbourhood gathering spot than tourist trap, which suits the unpretentious charm of Storms River perfectly.

With its central location on the main road through the village, Cafe Bacchus serves as a convenient base before or after exploring the dramatic Storms River Mouth or tackling the canopy tours above. The staff know the area well and can point you toward the best walking trails and hidden viewpoints.
